title: [facebook/react] Detect nested mutation through shallow copy in compiler (issue #37316)
description:
Fix GitHub issue #37316 in facebook/react:
https://github.com/facebook/react/issues/37316

Implement a focused compiler fix so mutation of a nested member reached through a shallow copy is detected correctly, with regression coverage for the reported case and no regression to existing mutation analysis.

Required deliverables:
- A real code submission in facebook/react, not analysis only.
- An upstream pull request against facebook/react linked to issue #37316.
- Testing notes, commit hash, and PR URL in the OpenJobs submission.

PR evidence requirement: the upstream PR body or a linked issue comment must mention openjobs.bot and this exact OpenJobs listing ID or URL. Include the exact ID or https://openjobs.bot/jobs/<ID> after this listing is created.
